question: On the same frozen roots, is zero opening exposure specific to direction (1,0), or do all absent direct-ray direction families lack an initial legal candidate?
changed_premise: The predeclared (1,0) screen returned 0/8 semantic candidates; source-path diagnosis found the first step blocked at every selected source, while aggregate opening-move filters passed.
selection: For every root, enumerate every present non-anchor, non-promotable generated type with nonempty legacy movement atoms; retain only directions for which that type has no legacy RayAtom of that direction, regardless of max_steps. No type or direction resampling.
template: One direct owner-relative ray action per eligible type-direction pair: min_steps=1, max_steps=3, target_relation=empty, composition=augment, one move(source,target) effect and own_anchor_safe invariant.
measurements: pairs with at least one legal initial semantic action
initial semantic candidate count per pair
interpretation: A finite root/template occupancy diagnostic only; it cannot show candidate survival after moves, rule quality, value calibration, utility or complete-domain coverage.
